study: Pregame baseline 90% plus standardized closing-spread MOV residual 10%
status: research only, no published model changes
formula: MOV residual = actual home scoring margin + home closing spread; opposite sign for away; capped +/-35; team mean shrunk by n/(n+4); standardized to FBS covered-team SD
providers: Consensus if available, else DraftKings if available, else sorted provider; provider consistency not guaranteed
limitations: CFBD /lines may represent available market lines, not timestamp-certified exact kickoff closes
Pregame baseline normalization uses all earlier games through week 6, not strictly walk-forward
10% applies to final overall rating; offensive and defensive ranks remain original
Incomplete book coverage and line-source changes could bias residuals
This is a rankings sensitivity comparison, not a prospective predictive validation
